name: 即食催熟绵密牛油果款
description: 催熟即食绵密如奶酪，四阶熟度任选，坏果包赔收货无忧

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshot and info screens, deep slate-blue aged wood #3C4654 with burlap linen for appetite hero scenes, soft light linen #F4F0E8 for table scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: warm directional soft key from the front-left with soft contact shadows on dark scene shots; bright even high-key flat lighting on white info screens; no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: aged slate-blue wood boards, coarse burlap linen, matte white ceramic plate and matte light board #EFE9E1
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2D2D2D on light screens and #FFFFFF on dark or orange screens, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: consistent solid hexagonal and circular badges plus thin-line icons, single accent color #E86A1E or #5E9C46
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent fruit scale across the set; halved fruit always shows pit centered
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh farm-to-table fruit ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white background #FFFFFF, deep slate-blue aged wood #3C4654, orchard green #5E9C46, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one vivid orange accent #E86A1E; warm directional soft key light with soft contact shadows on dark scenes and bright even high-key on white info screens; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal or white only; consistent solid hexagonal and circular info badges with thin-line icons; crisp appetizing fruit photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底首图
shots.camera: slight 3/4 view at eye-level, one whole fruit beside one halved fruit with pit facing camera
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Centered slight 3/4 view at eye-level, one whole fruit standing beside one halved fruit showing the pit toward the camera, full product visible and not clipped. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key and fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the fruit. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The fruit pair dominates the frame at 60-70%, scaled generously and perfectly centered so the white field frames it as one balanced packshot. 8K commercial fresh-produce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no decorative elements, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达绵密香醇的核心利益，暗调食欲场景拉开记忆点
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down at a 3/4 halved fruit with pit, whole fruits in a glass bowl behind
shots.lighting: warm directional soft key from the front-left, 4500K, soft contact shadow, gentle highlights on the flesh
shots.background: deep slate-blue aged wood #3C4654 with coarse burlap linen
shots.props: a clear glass bowl holding whole fruits, a few fresh green leaves, a draped burlap cloth
shots.textZone: top area over the wood with one headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one short ribbon label 「{callout_1}」 on an #E86A1E banner
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down at a halved fruit with the pit facing up, a glass bowl of whole fruits and burlap linen behind. Warm directional soft key from the front-left at 4500K, soft contact shadow. Background deep slate-blue aged wood #3C4654. The halved fruit and bowl anchor the lower two thirds at 50-60% of the frame, appetizing realistic flesh texture, and the upper third completes the composition over the dark wood with a headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #FFFFFF and one short ribbon label 「{callout_1}」 on a vivid orange #E86A1E banner. Negative: no discount numbers or price text, no invented claims, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 讲清产地特性、单果规格与储存方式，消除规格疑虑
shots.camera: straight-on flat frontal layout, no perspective, product pair inside a soft white circle on the right
shots.lighting: bright even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: a row of four solid #5E9C46 hexagonal badges along the bottom
shots.textZone: left column spec table with orange #E86A1E section title 「{selling_point_1}」 and label rows 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D; four hexagon badges along the bottom carrying short labels 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 「{callout_6}」 「{callout_7}」 in white
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic spec screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on flat frontal layout with no perspective. Left column: a clean spec table with an orange #E86A1E section title 「{selling_point_1}」 and three label rows 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 in #2D2D2D with thin divider lines. Right side: the fruit pair inside a soft white circle #FFFFFF. Bottom: four solid orchard-green #5E9C46 hexagonal badges carrying short white labels 「{callout_4}」 「{callout_5}」 「{callout_6}」 「{callout_7}」. Bright even high-key flat lighting, pure white background #FFFFFF. The spec table, product circle and badge row together fill 60-70% of the frame with even margins, reading as one balanced spec screen. Negative: no real weight, size or origin numbers rendered in-image, no dense body text, no tiny unreadable text, no watermark, no fake logo, no fabricated certifications.

shots.intent: 代入即食场景，展示切块吃法的真实餐桌感
shots.camera: photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead top-down angle
shots.lighting: soft natural diffused daylight from the upper left, 5500K, soft contact shadows
shots.background: matte white ceramic plate on soft light linen #F4F0E8
shots.props: one skin shell filled with fresh flesh cubes, a folded linen napkin, one or two green leaves
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} prepared for eating. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead top-down angle: one skin shell filled with fresh flesh cubes and one halved fruit on a matte white ceramic plate, on soft light linen #F4F0E8 with a folded napkin and one or two green leaves. Soft natural diffused daylight from the upper left at 5500K, soft contact shadows. The plate and props fill 40-50% of the frame as one complete airy flat-lay, the napkin and leaves balancing the linen field around them. Realistic fresh texture, believable casual styling. Negative: no hands, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no clutter, no duplicated background textures, no props covering the product.

shots.intent: 微距证明果肉厚度与果核状态，建立品质信任
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro on the halved cross-section, tight zoom on flesh-to-pit junction, shallow depth of field f/2.8, side profile angle
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing flesh grain and pit sheen, controlled highlight
shots.whitespace: minimal, the macro detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the halved cross-section where creamy flesh meets the round brown pit. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Side profile angle, shallow depth of field at f/2.8 with the foreground sharp. Raking side light from the right revealing fine flesh grain and a subtle pit sheen, controlled highlight. Blurred deep slate-blue wood #3C4654 background. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, margins minimal because the macro texture itself is the subject. Realistic moist flesh, no plastic look. Negative: no blurry subject, no plastic-looking flesh, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props.

shots.intent: 展示捣压即食的绵密质地，呼应如奶酪般顺滑的口感卖点
shots.camera: high 45-degree close-up looking down into the skin shell, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: soft warm key from the upper left at 4500K, gentle shadows inside the mash texture
shots.props: the empty skin shell holding mashed flesh
shots.textZone: one small corner label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D on a clean strip
shots.promptTemplate: Close-up food shot of {product} mashed to a creamy spread inside its own skin shell. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a high 45-degree angle looking down into the shell, shallow depth of field. Soft warm key from the upper left at 4500K, gentle shadows revealing the thick uneven mash texture. Matte light board #EFE9E1 background. The shell of mash fills 50-55% of the frame as the clear subject with even balanced margins, and one small corner label 「{callout_1}」 in #2D2D2D sits on a clean strip at the lower edge, completing the composition. Negative: no hands or utensils, no plastic-smooth fake texture, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no props covering the mash.

shots.intent: 按果皮色阶展示催熟进度，让买家按需选择到货即食或分批吃
shots.camera: straight-on frontal row shot, four fruits evenly spaced in one horizontal line
shots.lighting: even flat high-key lighting, identical on all four fruits, no direction drift
shots.background: soft light neutral grey #F2F2F0 with one thin horizontal guideline under the row
shots.props: four small dots on the guideline marking each fruit
shots.textZone: one short stage label under each fruit: 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 in #5E9C46
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant grid of {product}: four fruits in one straight frontal row showing a skin-color ripeness progression from greener to darker. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on frontal angle, four fruits evenly spaced, identical scale and identical even flat high-key lighting on every fruit, no lighting drift between them. Soft light neutral grey #F2F2F0 background with one thin horizontal guideline and four small #5E9C46 dots under the row. One short stage label sits under each fruit: 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 「{callout_4}」 in #5E9C46. The row fills 60-70% of the frame as one balanced linear composition with even margins above and below. Negative: no invented ripeness day counts or dates, no dense explanatory text, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no mismatched lighting between fruits.

shots.intent: 用售后承诺与防护包装降风险，化解生鲜收损顾虑
shots.camera: slight 3/4 product angle with the fruit in a foam protection net in the lower half
shots.lighting: even clean high-key studio light, no dramatic shadow
shots.props: one foam protection net on a fruit and one solid shield-shaped badge in #5E9C46
shots.textZone: one short trust headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D, two short labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」, and one white short label 「{callout_3}」 inside the shield badge
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen for {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 product angle: one fruit nested in a foam protection net sits in the lower half of the frame beside one solid shield-shaped badge in orchard green #5E9C46 carrying a short white label 「{callout_3}」. Even clean high-key studio light, pure white #FFFFFF background. One short trust headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #2D2D2D sits at the top with two short after-sales labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 beneath it. The netted fruit, shield badge and headline block together fill 50-60% of the frame as one balanced after-sales card. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, compensation amounts or time limits, no dense policy paragraphs, no QR code, no fake logos, no watermark.

shots.intent: 以箱装组合收口促单，用实色按钮与组合徽章把决策收束到下单
shots.camera: group 3/4 view, one kraft box beside a pile of fruits, low frontal angle for presence
shots.lighting: even soft studio light slightly punchier than the set, soft contact shadows
shots.props: one plain kraft shipping box with fruits spilling beside it
shots.textZone: one short CTA 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF on a deep charcoal #2D2D2D button shape, plus one rounded white badge 「{callout_2}」 in #FFFFFF
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing CTA shot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Group 3/4 view from a low frontal angle: one plain kraft shipping box with a pile of whole fruits spilling beside it, one halved fruit on top showing the pit. Even soft studio light with soft contact shadows, slightly punchier than the rest of the set. Solid vivid orange #E86A1E background. The box and fruit group fill 55-60% of the frame in the lower half; below them one short CTA 「{callout_1}」 in #FFFFFF sits on a deep charcoal #2D2D2D button shape, and one rounded white #FFFFFF badge with a short set label 「{callout_2}」 in #2D2D2D floats beside it, completing the balanced closing composition. Negative: no invented discounts or prices, no countdown timers, no QR code, no store badges, no watermark, no fake logo, no dense body text.

provenance.notes: 从 7 屏牛油果爆款详情长图提炼；已剥离产地（秘鲁/墨西哥表述）、营养功效大段文案、促销折扣语、会员二维码与店铺标识；单果重/理赔时效等原文数值一律不在图中呈现，由使用方按实际信息补充；品类按 taxonomy 判定为 生鲜粮油/水果。
